problem:
Consider the function $f(x)=-{x}^{3}-3{x}^{2}+24x-7.$

Earlier part 1:

Calculate ${f}^{′}(x).$

                            
                                    
                                        
                                            

                                                

                                        
                                        
                                        

                                    
                                
                                    
                                        
                                        ${f}^{′}(x)\,=\,$ 

                                    
                                
                                    
                            
                                        $-3x^2-6x+24$

Current part:

If $x={x}_{1}$ and $x={x}_{2}$ are the critical points of $f(x),$ what is the value of ${x}_{1}\cdot {x}_{2}?$

                            
                                    
                                        
                                            

                                                

                                        
                                        
                                        

                                    
                                
                                    
                                        
                                        ${x}_{1}\cdot {x}_{2}\,=\,$ 

                                    
                                
                                    
                            
                                        {{field-1}}

feedback.worked_solution:
We differentiate the function, applying the addition, constant multiple, and power rules:

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(-{x}^{3}-3{x}^{2}+24x-7) \\  & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(-{x}^{3})+\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(-3{x}^{2})+\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(24x)+\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(-7) \\  & =-\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}({x}^{3})-3\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}({x}^{2})+24\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(x)-7\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(1) \\  & =-3{x}^{(3-1)}-3\cdot 2{x}^{(2-1)}+24\cdot 1-7\cdot 0 \\  & =-3{x}^{2}-6x+24\end{aligned}
$$
